prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: seamless square PBR base-color texture for a realistic northern European tidal harbour game environment.
Primary request: orthographic close surface scan of old grey granite ashlar masonry, covering exactly a 2 metre square wall. Four horizontal courses of rectangular granite blocks, each course half a metre tall, varied block widths between 60 cm and 110 cm, staggered vertical joints. Thin irregular 8 mm grey mortar joints. Individual blocks have subtly rounded chipped edges and believable centuries-old rubbed and pecked stone grain; modest mottled mineral staining and a little pale dried salt at the joint edges. One restrained coherent grey granite palette with warm grey, cool grey and taupe block variation; no colourful granite. Tiny dark mica flecks, shallow tooling and pitting. A few fine cracks. Edge-to-edge surface only.
Lighting: perfectly diffuse flat scan lighting with no baked cast shadows, no directional highlights, no ambient vignette, no perspective.
Constraints: seamless on all four sides; joints repeat consistently at borders. Photographic physical material detail, never stylized or procedural noise. No moss, no plants, no objects, no frame, no writing, no labels, no watermark. Midtone material, no crushed blacks or pure whites.
